project.title: Masque Character Creator
project.summary: PF2e Remaster session-zero and character creator for The Masque of Shattered Mirrors—one player, one GM, spoiler-safe handoff.

items.title: Run a rehearsal with one player and one GM
items.notes: Confirm the campaign starting level. Have the player export their draft and the GM edit the brief, apply a revised player file, and reopen the exported GM package. Verify that it contains the revised character and the edited notes. Prepare Table View on the player's phone, turn on airplane mode, and refresh. During a short scene, time the Diplomacy modifier and Thievery training lookups, aiming for five seconds each. Have the player approve a question for The mask slips before the scene. Keep the printed card within reach and record whether the player opens or uses the prompt without a reminder. Record the biggest interruption and use it to choose the next improvement.

items.title: Export player characters for Pathbuilder
items.notes: Deferred at the maintainer’s request. Impact Med, effort Med. Revisit when Pathbuilder documents a supported format for importing external player builds. The 2026-11-11 review of Pathbuilder Web 112.0 and developer documentation found that Backup/Restore transfers native saves, Custom Pack imports rules content, and Export JSON sends character data out.

items.title: Verify the Foundry export in a live import
items.notes: Deferred at the maintainer’s request. Impact Med, effort Low. Import into a blank actor on the documented Foundry and PF2e target. Check level, attributes, skills, Lore, gear quantities, and carried status. Show the remaining foundation, feat, and spell setup before download.
